evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce PLE, a benchmark of 85 long-horizon, agentic tasks in professional physical engineering consisting of electrical, civil, structural and mechanical engineering, where solving a task means completing a realistic, billable engineering deliverable.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing engineering benchmarks focus on textbook question answering, isolated tool calls or self-contained toy design problems.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Co-Authored tasks start from problem statements written by practising engineers; an adversarial Creator-Solver agent pipeline constructs each task's realistic project environment, executable grader and reference deliverables before sending them to expert engineers for validation and difficulty intensification.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Even the strongest configuration reaches a mean score of only 50.6%, while spending 27M tokens and 63 minutes per task on average, demonstrating the substantial gap between current agents and autonomous physical engineering design.
